editorial_thesis: Agent capability becomes durable leverage when routing, memory provenance, and defensive evaluation are treated as control-plane primitives.

topic_groups.title: Agentic Engineering Systems
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh enterprise signal shifts the unit of adoption from model choice to governed engineering systems, with orchestration, cross-surface workflows, and explicit outcome measurement.

sources.title: GitHub Agentic Engineering System (AES)
sources.why_selected: A practical operating model for deciding where agents accelerate delivery and where human approval remains essential.
sources.usefulness: Use as a Buildn delivery checklist: responsibilities, shared instructions, guardrails, observability, and outcome metrics.

sources.title: Microsoft Agent Framework 1.22.0
sources.why_selected: A multi-provider framework release adds Python 3.15 metadata, tighter AG-UI trust boundaries, thread-bound continuations, and bounded response handling.
sources.usefulness: A reference for portable agent services with explicit session state, approvals, and provider adapters.

sources.title: LightAgent v0.11.0
sources.why_selected: An open-source framework adds persistent Dynamic DAG execution, verification-gated immutable artifacts, restart-safe leases, and narrowing-only security context.
sources.usefulness: Study its artifact and lease primitives for long-running Buildn jobs that must resume safely.

sources.title: Open Multi Agent
sources.why_selected: A newly active open project combines multi-agent orchestration, A2A/MCP, observability, self-hosting, and governance themes.
sources.usefulness: Use as a comparative architecture specimen for collaborative agents without vendor lock-in.

sources.title: HydraFusion enterprise orchestration trail
sources.why_selected: GitHub’s research preview frames model selection as single-model, cascade, and critique workflows instead of a single fixed model.
sources.usefulness: Prototype routing by task risk, latency, and reviewability rather than by benchmark score alone.

topic_groups.title: Memory as a Control Plane
topic_groups.selection_rationale: The freshest memory research is moving beyond recall quality toward provenance, source-family deduplication, variable context budgets, and procedural-personal memory separation.

sources.title: Memory Echo + MEchoBench
sources.why_selected: Repeated retrieval and write-back can make one historical claim look like independent evidence; MEchoBench measures echo density, persistence, and contamination.
sources.usefulness: Add source-family IDs, correction status, and authority to any durable agent memory.

sources.title: MemComposer
sources.why_selected: A learned composer chooses which memories to include, how many, and in what order, optimizing complete task outcomes rather than similarity alone.
sources.usefulness: Use a bounded memory-selection stage before the main agent, with token and success budgets.

sources.title: Memorizing Who, Knowing How
sources.why_selected: A benchmark separates personal memory from procedural memory for persistent assistants.
sources.usefulness: Design Buildn memory schemas with separate user facts, preferences, and executable workflow knowledge.

sources.title: nanoMuse: open personal agent
sources.why_selected: An open personal-agent proposal makes readable memory, provenance, local files, proactive behavior, and approval-backed actions explicit design requirements.
sources.usefulness: Use it as a product critique checklist for local-first personal-agent concepts.

sources.title: Memory Echo benchmark code
sources.why_selected: The companion implementation turns memory lifecycle claims into a reusable evaluation surface.
sources.usefulness: Adapt the benchmark shape for client knowledge bases and long-running research assistants.

topic_groups.title: Defensive Agent Evaluation
topic_groups.selection_rationale: New security research is making defense measurable: hidden vulnerabilities, cross-session artifacts, and attack-resistant harness behavior are becoming separate test surfaces.

sources.title: CWE-bench
sources.why_selected: A defensive benchmark uses 120 private repository tasks across 73 CWE types and all OWASP Top 10:2025 categories, requiring secure patches that preserve functionality.
sources.usefulness: Use its pass criteria for agentic code review: security block plus regression-free behavior.

sources.title: SkillRelayBench: cross-session artifact attacks
sources.why_selected: This work evaluates how persistent artifacts can carry attacks across otherwise reset agent sessions and compares modern coding-agent harnesses.
sources.usefulness: Threat-model skills, artifacts, caches, and workspaces as inter-session communication channels.

sources.title: EvolvAttack
sources.why_selected: A study of backdooring self-evolving vision-language agents highlights risk in systems that continually update memory and behavior.
sources.usefulness: Separate learning, memory-write, and policy-promotion permissions in adaptive workflows.

sources.title: AgentStripes maturity model
sources.why_selected: An evidence-graded maturity model treats the agent as a system with planning, tools, memory, environment interaction, and stopping behavior.
sources.usefulness: Turn maturity evidence into a client-facing readiness review instead of a model scorecard.

sources.title: NIST AI-agent security concept paper
sources.why_selected: NIST frames identity standards and best practices as prerequisites for secure adoption of software and AI agents.
sources.usefulness: Anchor identity, authorization, and accountability recommendations in a neutral public reference.
